# State online query purpose first and enforce its supported criteria

The online option says it queries the server instead of the local database, then states current limits: headerMessageId only and NNTP accounts only. The implementation throws when the required message ID is absent, filters accounts to nntp, tries them in order and returns the first external header through MessageListTracker, or an empty tracked list. This is not a general IMAP/POP online search. Review accepted purpose-before-limits documentation and explicit validation. The proposed new permission/localized install prompt remained follow-up in that discussion; its landing was not verified here.

Scope: Online message query contract and documentation.
